title: Design System: Learn Anything — The Answer Sheet (Colour Press)

print-ink.note: Maps to --primary. The structure ink: ink-block CTAs, filled (completed) bubbles, wordmark, walked rail connectors, caret, selection. Night-desk rendition inverts this role to paper ink #f2e8d8 on ground #17131f.

engage-blue.note: Maps to --engage (text --on-engage #fffaf0; --ring is this blue in both themes). Touches ONLY activity and interaction: focus rings, current/active bubbles, working+executing stamps, active nav tab, the REVEAL outline control, option hover, plan step letters, markdown links. Night desk: #58a6ff (#0a1526 text). Never static or structural color.

riso-pink-red.note: Maps to --error. The press's correction ink, re-pressed as riso. Reserved for misses, corrections, reveals, and the red sheet number only. Never success, never an inquiry identity. Night desk: #f5578d.

correction-field.note: Maps to --error-container. Background behind struck/missed answers and verdict panels. Night desk: #4b1027.

riso-green.note: Maps to --tertiary. Reserved strictly for verified/passed outcomes: the complete stamp, the correct option after a reveal, verdict lines. Never a confidence rung, never an inquiry identity. Night desk: #3fc578.

verified-field.note: Maps to --tertiary-container. Background behind verified/correct marks. Night desk: #143821.

pencil.note: Maps to --secondary. Meta/pending graphite voice; the mid rung of the confidence scale. Night desk: #a89b8a.

pencil-meta.note: Maps to --on-surface-variant. Meta copy, timestamps, unreached labels. Night desk: #b6ab9d.

press-paper.note: Maps to --background. Warm press-stock page ground, never pure white. Night desk: #17131f.

paper-white.note: Maps to --surface-container-lowest / --on-primary. The sheet itself: cards, option boxes, chips. Night desk: #100c17.

sheet-stock.note: Maps to --surface-container-low. Recessed form furniture: rail strip, dialog footers. Night desk: #1d1727.

rule.note: Maps to --outline-variant. Borders, ruled-paper lines, double rules, dashed ahead-connectors. Night desk: #453c55.

rule-strong.note: Maps to --outline. Stronger printed rules, quote borders, neutral verdict top rule. Night desk: #9a8fa0.

inq-blue.note: Maps to --inq-blue. One of the four inquiry identity inks (inquiryInk in lib/utils.ts, deterministic per session). Prints on sheet-card edges and sidebar step blocks only. Night desk: #58a6ff.

inq-flame.note: Maps to --inq-flame. Inquiry identity ink. Distinct hue family from the correction pink-red. Night desk: #ff8a4d.

inq-violet.note: Maps to --inq-violet. Inquiry identity ink. Night desk: #b39aff.

inq-ochre.note: Maps to --inq-ochre. Inquiry identity ink — the deep print of the highlighter family. Night desk: #e8b95c.

ink-on-spot.note: Maps to --on-inq. Text/fill on an inquiry spot block; flips to #17131f on the night desk's fluorescent spots.

highlighter-wash.note: The --marker pigment: riso yellow. Applied only as a translucent wash (48% light / 32% night desk) on the learner's own narrowed goal in the intake transcript. Bounded exception; nothing else may use it.

display.purpose: The record header band title and dialog masthead: Archivo 700 uppercase, widened tracking, closed by a double rule.

title.purpose: Sheet card goal titles, quiz prompts, session workspace header line.

body.purpose: All teaching copy and option text; plain Source Sans 3 at 15px+, legible at any age, never uppercase.

label.purpose: Monospace uppercase caps: stamps, rail step names, nav tabs, REVEAL, AGAIN/HARD/GOOD/EASY, verdict lines. The build's extension of the mono vocabulary to FORM labels.

code.purpose: Monospace data: red sheet numbers, zero-padded counters, timestamps, batch positions.

shadows.name: sheet (night desk)
shadows.value: 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, #453c55 80%, transparent), 0 2px 5px -2px color-mix(in oklab, #000 45%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: --shadow-sheet at rest: the sheet's edge contact on the desk.

shadows.name: sheet (riso paper)
shadows.value: 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, #d3c6b0 90%, transparent), 0 2px 5px -2px color-mix(in oklab, #181420 22%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: --shadow-sheet on paper: 1px edge line plus a tight ink-tinted drop.

shadows.name: sheet-raised (night desk)
shadows.value: 0 2px 0 color-mix(in oklab, #453c55 90%, transparent), 0 8px 18px -6px color-mix(in oklab, #000 55%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: --shadow-sheet-raised hover/attention state, paired with a -1px translate. The only second level.

shadows.name: stamp inner rule
shadows.purpose: The inner border of a real stamp's double outline, tinted from the stamp's own ink; 2px inset on the 96px completion stamp.

shadows.name: halftone screen
shadows.purpose: The press's dot screen (the halftone utility). Printed in exactly two places: behind the record header band's CTA end (engage blue, 13%, md and up) and beside the login wordmark (blue, 25%). A signature accent, not required decoration.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The single easing shared by every authored moment; exponential ease-out from an already-visible default.

motion.name: bubble-fill
motion.purpose: A progress bubble inks in (scale 0.5→1, opacity 0.4→1). Quiz answers and rail steps.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.purpose: A stamp settles from scale 1.08 / rotate -4° / 1px blur to rest at rotate -2°.

motion.name: sheet-settle
motion.purpose: A sheet card lands on the desk (6px rise); list cards stagger 40ms apart, capped at 320ms.

motion.name: pen-draw
motion.purpose: The red-pen cross: two hand-drawn pathLength strokes, never an icon dash trick.

motion.name: dot-breathe
motion.purpose: The breathing engagement-blue dot inside a current bubble.

motion.name: reduced-motion guard
motion.purpose: Every authored animation is switched off; the flow never depends on motion to be understood.

components.name: Ink Block Button
components.description: The page's single heavy primary CTA — a solid print-ink block resting at sheet contact, lifting one step on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ink"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Start New Session</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--primary, #181420); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fffaf0); padding: 12px 20px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sheet, 0 1px 0 #d3c6b0, 0 2px 5px -2px rgba(24,20,32,0.22)); transition: all 150ms; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sheet-raised, 0 2px 0 #d3c6b0, 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(24,20,32,0.3)); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1450a3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Reveal Control (outline stamp)
components.description: A hard 3px outline-stamp control with monospace caps, printed in engagement blue because revealing is interaction; hover fills blue with paper text.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-reveal"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-3.5 7-10 7-10-7-10-7Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>Reveal</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-reveal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--engage, #1450a3); border: 2px solid var(--engage, #1450a3); border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 20px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-btn-reveal:hover { background: var(--engage, #1450a3); color: var(--on-engage, #fffaf0); } .ds-btn-reveal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1450a3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Confidence Controls (AGAIN / HARD / GOOD / EASY)
components.description: The graded scale chips: a 3px top rule carries the rung (riso pink-red lapse → pencil → ink container → filled ink); no green appears in the scale. Hover adopts the rung color. Disabled while a recording is in flight.
components.css: .ds-confidence-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-confidence { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #fffaf0); color: var(--on-surface, #181420); border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0); border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; transition: all 150ms; } .ds-confidence .ds-rule { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 3px; } .ds-is-again .ds-rule { background: var(--error, #c81e5b); } .ds-is-hard .ds-rule { background: var(--secondary, #5f5643); } .ds-is-good .ds-rule { background: var(--primary-container, #2a2430); } .ds-is-easy .ds-rule { background: var(--primary, #181420); } .ds-is-again:hover { border-color: var(--error, #c81e5b); color: var(--error, #c81e5b); } .ds-is-hard:hover { border-color: var(--secondary, #5f5643); color: var(--on-surface, #181420); } .ds-is-good:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #181420); color: var(--primary, #181420); } .ds-is-easy:hover { background: var(--primary, #181420); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fffaf0); } .ds-confidence:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1450a3); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-confidence:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Quiz Option Box
components.description: A printed lettered option; hover shifts the border to engagement blue (the interaction ink). Revealed states: correct marked green, wrong pick struck with the red-pen cross.
components.css: .ds-options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #fffaf0); color: var(--on-surface, #181420); border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: var(--engage, #1450a3); } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1450a3); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-text { flex: 1; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; } .ds-letter { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0); border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #4d4438); } .ds-reveal-correct { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tertiary, #167a3f) 60%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tertiary-container, #c9e8d2) 50%, transparent); color: var(--tertiary, #167a3f); } .ds-letter-correct { border-color: var(--tertiary, #167a3f); background: var(--tertiary, #167a3f); color: var(--on-tertiary, #fffaf0); } .ds-reveal-wrong { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--error, #c81e5b) 60%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--error-container, #f9dbe4) 40%, transparent); color: var(--error, #c81e5b); } .ds-letter-wrong { border-color: var(--error, #c81e5b); background: var(--error, #c81e5b); color: var(--on-error, #fffaf0); }

components.name: Sheet Card (History / Review deck)
components.description: A filed answer sheet: the inquiry's identity spot as a 5px press edge on the left, punch-hole margin, ruled header strip with a red monospace sheet number, title below. Carries no stage vocabulary (product decision #46).

components.css: .ds-sheet-card { display: block; position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #fffaf0); color: var(--on-surface, #181420); border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0); border-radius: 6px; padding: 20px 20px 20px 32px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sheet, 0 1px 0 #d3c6b0, 0 2px 5px -2px rgba(24,20,32,0.22)); transition: all 150ms; text-decoration: none; } .ds-sheet-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sheet-raised, 0 2px 0 #d3c6b0, 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(24,20,32,0.3)); } .ds-sheet-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #1450a3); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-spot { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 5px; } .ds-punches { position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; } .ds-punches i { display: block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0) 70%, transparent); background: var(--surface, #f8f2e6); } .ds-sheet-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0) 60%, transparent); padding-bottom: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-sheet-no { font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--error, #c81e5b); } .ds-sheet-time { color: var(--on-surface-variant, #4d4438); } .ds-sheet-title { margin-top: 12px; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Phase Stamp
components.description: The phase vocabulary: a rotated, double-outlined monospace-caps stamp. Shown working (engagement-blue dashed), executing (filled engagement blue), verified (green), and correction (pink-red).
components.html: Probing Drilling Complete
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; transform: rotate(-2deg); border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 35%, transparent); } .ds-stamp-working { color: var(--engage, #1450a3); border-style: dashed; } .ds-stamp-executing { color: var(--on-engage, #fffaf0); background: var(--engage, #1450a3); border-color: var(--engage, #1450a3); } .ds-stamp-complete { color: var(--tertiary, #167a3f); }

components.name: Progress Rail & Bubbles
components.description: The sole progress device: a printed row of bubbles and mono-caps step labels; done steps join with a solid ink rule, ahead steps with a dashed rule. Bubbles: empty, filled (ink), current (blue ring + breathing blue dot), active (filled blue).
components.html: ClarifyingProbingPlanning
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; width: 100%; background: var(--surface-container-low, #fcf5e8); padding: 12px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 -2px var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0); } .ds-step { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-bubble { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0); } .ds-bubble-filled { border-color: var(--primary, #181420); background: var(--primary, #181420); } .ds-bubble-current { border-color: var(--engage, #1450a3); } .ds-bubble-current i { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: auto; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--engage, #1450a3); } .ds-bubble-active { border-color: var(--engage, #1450a3); background: var(--engage, #1450a3); } .ds-step-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #4d4438); } .ds-step-label.ds-current { color: var(--primary, #181420); } .ds-link { flex: 1; margin: 0 8px; margin-top: 7px; height: 2px; background: var(--primary, #181420); } .ds-link:not(.ds-link-walked) { height: 0; border-top: 1px dashed var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0); background: none; }

components.name: Counter Chip (form page number)
components.description: Zero-padded monospace slide/progress counter, typeset like a printed form page number.
components.css: .ds-counter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #fffaf0); border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #d3c6b0); border-radius: 3px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #4d4438); } .ds-counter b { font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary, #181420); }

narrative.overview:
Study is a sheet you fill in. Every surface is printed paper: a record header closed by a double rule, sessions as paper cards punched for a binder, questions as lettered option boxes, progress as a row of filled bubbles, phase as a rotated rubber stamp pressed onto the page. The system holds to a colour press — ink-black carries the structure, engagement blue marks activity, riso pink-red corrects, riso green verifies, pencil annotates, and every inquiry is printed in its own spot color, so the History reads as a color-coded map of what you are curious about — on a warm press-paper ground with a faint grain (3.5% opacity) that says "sheet", not "panel".

The world ships in two complete renditions: riso paper (light) and the night desk (dark, the same press inverted with fluorescent inks). No role changes meaning between them. The color system was replaced on 2026-10-02 by the owner's chosen "Colour Press" direction; every non-color rule of the Answer Sheet world carries forward unchanged.

Type carries the same printed-form logic: Archivo sets record headers like a printed masthead; Source Sans 3 is the plain body voice legible at any age; JetBrains Mono is the form's own hand — codes, counters, and the caps pressed into stamps and controls.
keyCharacteristics: Colour-press discipline: ink structures; engagement blue touches only activity and interaction; pink-red corrects; green verifies; pencil annotates; inquiry spots identify.
Every inquiry carries a deterministic identity spot (blue / flame / violet / ochre) on its sheet edge and sidebar step blocks — History reads as a color-coded map of curiosities.
Bubbles are the sole progress device — empty, filled (ink), current (blue ring + breathing blue dot), or active (filled blue). No progress bars.
Stamps (slightly rotated, double-ruled, monospace caps) are the phase vocabulary; session cards carry no stage vocabulary at all (product decision #46).
Square-cut form geometry: form surfaces at or below 6px radius; full circles reserved for bubbles and punch holes.
Ruled-paper panels, double-rule dividers, a ruled meta strip with a red monospace "No." on every sheet card, and the halftone dot screen printed in exactly two signature places.
No glow, no gradients, no glass. Depth is the contact shadow of paper on a desk.

rules.name: The Colour Press Rule
rules.body: Every color in the app holds its reserved role: ink structures, the blue touches only activity and interaction, pink-red corrects, green verifies, pencil annotates, inquiry spots identify. A color that crosses its reservation is a bug, not a variant.

rules.name: The Identity Is Not a Verdict Rule
rules.body: The inquiry fan is exactly blue / flame / violet / ochre, assigned deterministically per session; it deliberately excludes the correction pink-red and the verified green. Identity is never a verdict.

rules.name: The Red Sheet Number Rule
rules.body: Every filed sheet prints its identity as a red monospace "No." on its ruled header strip. It is the card's fingerprint, not decoration.

rules.name: The Highlighter Exception
rules.body: --marker (riso yellow wash) is the one wash outside the press, bounded to the learner's own narrowed goal in the intake transcript. A highlighter belongs on an answer sheet — but only on the learner's own answer.

rules.name: The Printed-Form Rule
rules.body: Headings are set like a printed form: Archivo, uppercase where it is a form header or masthead, with widened tracking. The teaching voice itself is never uppercase and never the display face.

rules.name: The Mono-Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the form's hand: codes and counters per the brief, extended by the build to FORM labels — the caps on stamps, nav tabs, and the REVEAL / AGAIN / HARD / GOOD / EASY controls. Mono never sets body copy or teaching prose.

rules.name: The Sheet-Contact Rule
rules.body: Every lifted thing shows its edge. A shadow is always a contact line plus a tight drop; anything diffuse, wide, or colored is outside this world.

rules.name: The One Ink Block Rule
rules.body: Each page carries exactly one heavy solid-ink primary CTA; everything else is an outline, a chip, or a plain link.

rules.name: The Bubble-Only Progress Rule
rules.body: Progress is a row of bubbles in four states only — empty, filled, current, active. There are no bars, rings, or percentage meters.

dos: Do keep every color inside its press role: ink structures, the engagement blue only marks activity and interaction (focus, current, running, active nav, reveal), pink-red only corrects, green only verifies, pencil only annotates.
Do give each inquiry its spot from inquiryInk and use it only as identity — sheet-card edge and sidebar step blocks.
Do mark progress with bubbles only — empty, filled, current, active — and connect walked steps with solid ink rules, ahead steps with dashed ones.
Do set phase as a stamp: rotated -2 degrees, double-outlined, monospace caps, pressed in; blue while working, green when complete, pink-red on error.
Do file every sheet the same way: punch-hole margin, ruled header strip, red monospace "No.", 6px corners, sheet-contact shadow.
Do give each page exactly one ink block — the heavy solid-ink primary CTA.
Do use the highlighter wash (--marker) on the learner's own narrowed goal in intake, and there only.
Do keep type legible at any age in both scripts: Source Sans 3 body at 15px+, uppercase Archivo only for form headers, mono only for codes/counters/form labels.
Do ship every surface in both renditions — riso paper and night desk — from the same role tokens.
donts: Don't use pink-red on anything that succeeded, or green on anything unverified (including the confidence scale).
Don't assign the correction pink-red or the verified green as an inquiry identity spot; the fan is blue / flame / violet / ochre.
Don't use the engagement blue on anything static or structural — headings, sheet bodies, completed bubbles stay ink.
Don't put stage or phase vocabulary on session cards (product decision #46).
Don't round form surfaces past 8px; full circles are reserved for bubbles and punch holes.
Don't use glow, gradients, glass, or diffuse ambient shadows — depth is contact plus a tight drop.
Don't use progress bars, rings, or percentage meters; the bubble row is the progress device.
Don't treat LLM-authored slide content in the sandbox iframe as app chrome; the system frames it, never styles it from outside.
Don't invent a second highlighter, a second accent family, or a decorative color; the press has its quota.
